text: The Clean Air Investment Trust Ventures Inc. (CVI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Toronto Atmospheric Fund. Its Board of Directors is made up of at least three members of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board. An appointment to the CVI Board is recommended given a departure from the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Removed Mike Layton from the Board of Directors of Clean Air Investment Trust Ventures Inc. 2. Appointed Dianne Saxe to the Board of Directors of Clean Air Investment Trust Ventures Inc.
